name: Extend existing code
description: For adding a feature to a codebase that already exists. A codebase analyst reviews the current code first and maps exactly which files and functions the feature has to change; the Planner designs from that map and you see both before anything is built.

steps.name: Codebase analyst
steps.purpose: Reviews the code that already exists and shows exactly where the new feature has to change it.
reads: the existing code in this workspace
README and docs in this workspace
produces: .devcrew/codebase-review.md: overview, health findings, a change map per feature, and risks

steps.title: Review the code analysis and the plan

steps.name: Reviewer
steps.purpose: Gives a second opinion on the code: design, clarity and security, the things tests cannot see.
produces: .devcrew/review.md: a verdict and findings by severity
